sub: Lanta is the slower Andaman island: space and a scooter week, not a party village. Stay north for boats and dinner. Stay south for empty sand.
body: Lanta is the slower Andaman island: space and a scooter week, not a party village. Stay north for boats and dinner. Stay south for empty sand. Koh Lanta is a long west-facing island, known for space and a slower Andaman week. It is not a village around one bay. Boats from Krabi Town (Klong Jilad) and Ao Nang (Nopparat Thara) land at Saladan from about November to April and take about 2 to 2.5 hours. From May to October those boats thin out or stop. The road still works: van to the mainland Hua Hin pier (this is not the gulf resort), a short car ferry to Lanta Noi of about 15 minutes, then the bridge onto Lanta Yai. Pair Lanta with Krabi or Phuket, not with Samui. The Andaman monsoon is the rule here. Koh Rok and Koh Haa snorkel boats follow the same winter window. Many south-end resorts close in the wet months. Check that your hotel is actually open. sub: Khao Lak is a long, quiet Andaman beach, not a Phuket suburb. Sleep here for Similan mornings. Do not sleep here for nightlife.
body: Khao Lak is a long, quiet Andaman beach, not a Phuket suburb. Sleep here for Similan mornings. Do not sleep here for nightlife. Khao Lak is the long-beach Similan base in Phang Nga, north of the Sarasin Bridge. From Phuket Airport you drive Highway 402 off the island and north on Highway 4. Nang Thong is about 70 minutes without traffic. Bang Niang is a few minutes farther. Khuk Khak and Laem Pakarang sit later still. There is no airport and no ferry. It is a car. The Similan Islands are a national park, not a hotel strip. The Department of National Parks opens them from 15 October to 15 May and closes them from 16 May to 14 October every year so the reef can rest and so the southwest monsoon does not sink day boats. Phuket pickups add a long pre-dawn road. body: Pai is a mountain night after 762 bends, not a first-week must. The Mae Hong Son Loop is about 600 km. Give it four days or skip it. Pai is the mountain town at the end of Route 1095. From Chiang Mai you take Route 107 to Mae Malai, then 762 bends over the ridge. Minivans do it in about 3.5 hours. A scooter does it in the same time if you do not stop, and in a full day if you do. title: Sukhothai
sub: Sukhothai is lotus-bud chedis you ride between on a bicycle, not a Bangkok day trip, so sleep in Old Sukhothai and treat the new town as a taxi if you land late.
body: Sukhothai is lotus-bud chedis you ride between on a bicycle, not a Bangkok day trip, so sleep in Old Sukhothai and treat the new town as a taxi if you land late. Sukhothai is the 13th-century capital, known for lotus-bud chedis you bicycle at opening. The Fine Arts Department splits the park. The inner historic zone is the one you came for: Wat Mahathat, Wat Sa Si, Wat Si Sawai. Their virtual park page lists 200 THB for foreign visitors in the inner zone, 120 THB each for the northern zone (Wat Si Chum, Wat Phra Phai Luang) and the western Aranyik zone, or 400 THB as a combined rate. Thai tickets are 20 THB a zone. Bicycles pay 10 THB a zone at the gate. An older QR page still shows 100 THB. Go by the price posted at the staffed ticket booth. Inner-zone hours on that official page are 06:30 to 19:30 Monday to Friday and Sunday, and 06:30 to 21:00 on Saturday. Wat Si Chum and Wat Phra Phai Luang list 07:30 to 17:30. Aranyik lists 08:00 to 16:30. Office line: 055 697 527. Si Satchanalai is a separate park to the north. It is a second morning, not a footnote. Lunch is [Sukhothai noodles](/thai-food/sukhothai), not a Bangkok day-trip snack. title: Ayutthaya
sub: Ayutthaya is the ruin day from Bangkok. Take the train from Krung Thep Aphiwat, move by bicycle or tuk-tuk, and leave on an afternoon train unless you want dawn.
body: Ayutthaya is the ruin day from Bangkok. Take the train from Krung Thep Aphiwat, move by bicycle or tuk-tuk, and leave on an afternoon train unless you want dawn. Ayutthaya is the island city of brick prangs and root-wrapped Buddhas, an hour north of Bangkok. The Fine Arts Department lists paid monuments at 80 THB each for foreign visitors or 300 THB as a flat ticket (Thai 10 / 40). The combo usually covers Wat Phra Si Sanphet, Wat Mahathat, Wat Ratchaburana, Wat Phra Ram, Wat Chaiwatthanaram, and a sixth site. Ask the booth which names are on today's stub. Hours on the department page read 08:00 or 08:30 to 18:00 or 18:30; Wat Phra Si Sanphet and Wat Ratchaburana often sell last tickets earlier. Office: 035 242 286. Ordinary and express trains still make Ayutthaya in about an hour from Krung Thep Aphiwat. SRT also runs commuter sets on this line. Weekend tourist extras appear and vanish; check the board, not a screenshot. From the station you need a tuk-tuk, a bicycle, or a long hot walk. Wat Chaiwatthanaram sits off the island to the west. Wat Mahathat's root-wrapped head is the photograph everyone already has. Go at opening if you want it without a queue. Eat using the [Ayutthaya food guide](/thai-food/ayutthaya): boat-noodle cups, roti sai mai, then river prawns if you overnight. title: Kanchanaburi
sub: Kanchanaburi is the River Kwai town plus Erawan falls. Give it two nights if you want both. The bridge is a morning. Hellfire Pass and the seven tiers do not fit the same afternoon.
body: Kanchanaburi is the River Kwai town plus Erawan falls. Give it two nights if you want both. The bridge is a morning. Hellfire Pass and the seven tiers do not fit the same afternoon. Kanchanaburi is a river town west of Bangkok, not an island and not a ruin loop. The steel bridge and Khwae Yai Bridge station are the postcard. The Thailand-Burma Railway Centre and the allied war cemetery are the part that should take longer than the selfie. Hellfire Pass (Konyu Cutting) is about 80 km northwest, by road past Nam Tok, with an Australian-run interpretive centre. The cutting is a memorial walk, not a waterfall stop. Ordinary SRT trains to Kanchanaburi and Nam Tok leave from Thonburi station on the west bank. They have not moved to Krung Thep Aphiwat. That is the mistake first-timers make. Weekend tourist extras sometimes use Hua Lamphong; read the train number. Tickets on the ordinary sets are often day-of, third class. Foreign tourist fares apply. Floods have shut the Tha Kilen to Nam Tok stretch before; check SRT 1690 before you plan the viaduct as a must. Thonburi station, not Krung Thep Aphiwat 300 THB foreign adult, cash at the gate Seven tiers, about 65 to 70 km from town Two if you want falls plus the line Closed since 27 Sep 2026, until further notice

title: Hua Hin
sub: Hua Hin is Bangkok's old royal beach, the Gulf without a boat. Sleep in town for the night market, or toward Khao Takiab for the hill and Cicada.
body: Hua Hin is Bangkok's old royal beach, the Gulf without a boat. Sleep in town for the night market, or toward Khao Takiab for the hill and Cicada. Hua Hin is a mainland Gulf resort in Prachuap Khiri Khan, not an island and not Pattaya. The beach runs about 7 km from the fishing pier to the limestone hill at Khao Takiab. The water is shallow and often murky after rain. You come for a walkable town, seafood, and a train you can board with a suitcase, not for a postcard lagoon. Special Express 43 leaves Krung Thep Aphiwat at 07:30 and is the clean morning option, about three hours. Other southbound trains take longer. Minivans from Ekkamai work and then dump you in traffic. Hua Hin Airport is not a useful Bangkok substitute. Avoid Thai long weekends unless you like full trains and full beach roads. Town dinner lives on the [Hua Hin food guide](/thai-food/hua-hin): Soi 72, then Naresdamri if you want a sit-down fish. About 3 hours from Krung Thep Aphiwat; Special Express 43 is the useful morning set Easier November to April; October is the wet month Friday to Sunday, 16:00 to 23:00, toward Khao Takiab HHQ is not your Bangkok hop; take the train

title: Bangkok to Koh Phangan
sub: Koh Phangan is the Gulf island north of Samui, known for west-coast bays and one Full Moon beach. There is no airport. Fly to Samui and boat to Thong Sala, or sleep on the Chumphon train and take the morning catamaran.
body: Koh Phangan is the Gulf island north of Samui, known for west-coast bays and one Full Moon beach. There is no airport. Fly to Samui and boat to Thong Sala, or sleep on the Chumphon train and take the morning catamaran. Everyone lands at a pier. Thong Sala on the southwest is the useful one. Lomprayah, Seatran Discovery, Songserm, Raja, and Boonsiri each use a named berth. Read the operator on the ticket. Haad Rin boats are for Full Moon, not a normal arrival. The short day: fly into Samui Airport (USM), ride to the Samui boat pier, then the Lomprayah catamaran to Thong Sala in about 30 minutes (Seatran takes about 45). The cheap night: a Lomprayah bus from Khaosan or Pinklao to Thung Makham Noi in Chumphon, then a morning catamaran that often calls at Koh Tao. The train version sleeps better. Board at Krung Thep Aphiwat, the main Bangkok station, then take a booked van to the pier. BKK or DMK to USM, then Lomprayah to Thong Sala Sleeper to Chumphon, catamaran from Thung Makham Noi Thong Sala; Haad Rin is a different boat Easier January to September; swell can delay boats

title: Bangkok to Koh Tao
sub: Koh Tao is the dive island past Phangan. There is no airport. Everyone lands at Mae Haad. Fly to Samui and boat north if Samui is already on the ticket. Take the Chumphon train plus catamaran if Tao is the only stop.
body: Koh Tao is the dive island past Phangan. There is no airport. Everyone lands at Mae Haad. Fly to Samui and boat north if Samui is already on the ticket. Take the Chumphon train plus catamaran if Tao is the only stop. Mae Haad is the west-coast pier. Lomprayah, Seatran Discovery, and Songserm use adjacent berths. Boonsiri uses its own nearby pier. A 20 THB environmental charge is collected on arrival. Songthaews to Sairee or Chalok cost more than the fee. Agree the fare before you climb in. If Tao is the only stop, the Chumphon path is the clean one: sleeper or night bus to the mainland, morning boat, Sairee by lunch. If you already fly USM for Samui or Phangan, stay on the island boats and do not backtrack through Chumphon. Mae Haad, west coast Thung Makham Noi, Chumphon USM, then Lomprayah via Phangan 20 THB environmental charge at the pier

title: Bangkok to Krabi: 75-min KBV flight plus Ao Nang transfer
sub: Krabi is known for Ao Nang beaches and the Railay cliffs. Fly to Krabi Airport (KBV). The night train is not the first-trip move.
body: Krabi is known for Ao Nang beaches and the Railay cliffs. Fly to Krabi Airport (KBV). The night train is not the first-trip move. Krabi Airport sits north of Krabi Town, not on the beach. Ao Nang is a 30 to 50 minute car depending on the causeway. Railay is a longtail from Ao Nang or from the Klong Jilad side, not a taxi to the sand. Tell the driver the beach or the pier, not "Krabi". 2026 published BKK-KBV or DMK-KBV seats often sit at 1,200 to 4,500 THB ($35 to $130) one way. Thai AirAsia and Nok use Don Mueang. Thai Vietjet and Bangkok Airways use Suvarnabhumi. Match the Bangkok airport you already hold. A cross-town airport change can erase the flight. About 75 minutes, BKK or DMK to KBV. sub: Koh Lanta is the long Andaman island south of Krabi, known for west-coast beaches and a slower pace than Phi Phi. In season, boat to Saladan; all year, take the road and the car ferry from Hua Hin pier on the Krabi side, which is in Krabi province, not the gulf resort town.

Koh Lanta Yai is a long west-facing island. Boats land at Saladan. Hotels sit down a single west-coast road. Book a pickup when you book the room. A tuk-tuk at Saladan is not a Bangkok habit. All year, the road and the car ferry from Hua Hin pier on the Krabi side still work. From Krabi Town, passenger boats leave Klong Jilad mainly November to April. title: Phuket to Koh Samui
sub: Phuket and Samui face different seas. The useful hop is a Bangkok Airways flight of about 55 minutes. The cheap path is a van to Donsak plus a ferry. You will arrive late.
body: Phuket and Samui face different seas. The useful hop is a Bangkok Airways flight of about 55 minutes. The cheap path is a van to Donsak plus a ferry. You will arrive late. The Andaman is easier November to April. The Lower Gulf is easier January to September. Crossing them is a transport problem, not a beach hop. The useful air answer is Bangkok Airways, the only regular HKT-USM nonstop, about 55 minutes on ATR or similar. Kayak-style inventories list Economy only on this sector. Blue Ribbon Club lounge access at HKT or USM is a paid upgrade from the Boutique Lounge, not a cabin on the plane. The land answer is a morning van from the Lomprayah Phuket Town office or Phuket Bus Terminal 2 to Donsak, then a boat to Nathon, Bangrak, or Lipa Noi. Read the arrival pier. Do not treat this as one monsoon

title: Surat Thani to Khao Sok
sub: Khao Sok is known for Cheow Lan Lake and jungle trails. From Surat Thani the village and the lake pier are an hour apart. Buy the transfer that matches the bed you booked.
body: Khao Sok is known for Cheow Lan Lake and jungle trails. From Surat Thani the village and the lake pier are an hour apart. Buy the transfer that matches the bed you booked. Khao Sok village sits by the park headquarters and the Sok River. Cheow Lan Lake, also written Chiao Lan, sits behind Ratchaprapha Dam about 60 to 65 km east of that village. They share a park name and not a pier. A van that says "Khao Sok" will dump you at the village unless the ticket says Ratchaprapha or Cheow Lan. From Surat Thani town or Phunphin station the village is a westbound Highway 401 ride, about 1.5 to 2 hours. From URT the same vans run after the bags. If you booked a floating raft house, skip the village and go to Ratchaprapha Pier. The longtail is 35 minutes to more than an hour depending on the raft. About 1.5 to 2 hours west of Surat Thani town on Highway 401 Ratchaprapha Pier (Cheow Lan), Ban Ta Khun URT, then a van. Do not walk out looking for the lake 300 THB foreign adult per zone, cash; lake is a second ticket

title: Chiang Mai to Pai: 3.5-4.5 hr van on Route 1095
sub: Pai is the mountain town over Route 1095, known for 762 bends and a walking-street night. Take a Prempracha minivan from Chiang Mai Arcade. Sleep there. A same-day out-and-back is a wasted Saturday.
body: Pai is the mountain town over Route 1095, known for 762 bends and a walking-street night. Take a Prempracha minivan from Chiang Mai Arcade. Sleep there. A same-day out-and-back is a wasted Saturday. Pai is a mountain night, not a Chiang Mai district. You leave on Route 107 to Mae Malai, then 1095 over the ridge. The local count is 762 bends. Minivans do it in about 3.5 to 4.5 hours. A scooter does it in the same time if you do not stop, and in a full day if you do. Pai Airport has had no scheduled commercial flights since 2017. Prempracha Transport holds the licensed service (route 612 toward Pang Mapha and Mae Hong Son). Vans leave Chiang Mai Arcade roughly hourly from 06:30 to 16:30, with a few minibus sets mixed in. Walk-up fares sit around 210 to 250 THB; online desks add a cut. They take a passport number. Confirm the counter letter on the ticket. title: Bangkok to Ayutthaya
sub: Ayutthaya is known for its island of temples, an easy train day from Bangkok. Fast trains leave Krung Thep Aphiwat. Slow cheap trains still leave Hua Lamphong. Do not Grab the whole way unless you like the expressway.

title: Monsoon and burn season
sub: Thailand is a two-calendar country plus a smoky north, not one winter. Phuket and Krabi are easier November to April. Samui and Phangan are easier January to September. Check Chiang Mai air before you book March.
body: Thailand is a two-calendar country plus a smoky north, not one winter. Phuket and Krabi are easier November to April. Samui and Phangan are easier January to September. Check Chiang Mai air before you book March. The southwest monsoon hits the Andaman first. Phuket, Krabi, Lanta, Lipe, and Khao Lak are the November to April trip. The Lower Gulf (Samui, Phangan, Tao) is the January to September trip. October is the messy overlap. Do not stack both seas on a first week. Bangkok to either coast is about 70 to 85 minutes by air. The north has a different problem. Crop and forest smoke sits in the Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai valleys at the end of the dry season. Station averages for 2023 to 2026 put Chiang Mai's nastiest month in April. May rain usually clears it. Bangkok heat is year-round and is not this page. title: Scooters and road rules
sub: Scooters are how many visitors get hurt. A car licence does not cover a scooter, even a small automatic. You need a motorcycle licence and an International Driving Permit that lists motorcycles. If you cannot show both, take the van.
body: Scooters are how many visitors get hurt. A car licence does not cover a scooter, even a small automatic. You need a motorcycle licence and an International Driving Permit that lists motorcycles. If you cannot show both, take the van. Thai law does not split scooters out of motorcycles. A 110 cc Honda Click and a 400 cc bike both need a motorcycle endorsement. A 2026 scooter rental is often 200 to 350 THB a day plus petrol. The tourist path is your full home motorcycle licence carried with an International Driving Permit that lists category A (or the 1949 motorcycle class). Thailand accepts 1949 and, since May 2021, 1968 convention IDPs. The IDP is a translation. It cannot add a class you do not hold. A UK CBT is training, not a full licence. An ASEAN motorcycle licence works without an IDP. A Thai car licence does not cover a scooter either. Police checkpoints on Phuket, Samui, and 1095 ask. Insurers ask after the crash. The shop that rented you a bike with a passport photocopy will not write the claim. title: 10-Day Thailand Itinerary: Bangkok, Chiang Mai, one coast
sub: This is the classic first trip: city, north, one beach. Use the monsoon to pick Phuket and Krabi or Samui and Tao. Do not stack both seas.
body: This is the classic first trip: city, north, one beach. Use the monsoon to pick Phuket and Krabi or Samui and Tao. Do not stack both seas. The classic first trip is Bangkok, Chiang Mai, and one south coast. Ten nights is enough for that. It is not enough for two seas. Sleep three nights in Bangkok, three in Chiang Mai, then four on the coast the monsoon allows. Book hotel bases, not a new room every night. Fly the long legs. Bangkok to Chiang Mai is about 70 minutes. The useful night train is SRT 9 northbound (Krung Thep Aphiwat to Chiang Mai, about 18:40 to 07:15) and SRT 10 southbound (Chiang Mai to Krung Thep Aphiwat, about 18:20 to 06:30), about 12 hours, if you want to save a day-room. The south hop is a second flight: CNX or BKK to HKT or KBV in winter, USM in the Gulf summer. A 2026 BTS tap is 17 to 62 THB. Grand Palace is 500 THB. Wat Pho is 300 THB. sub: Two Andaman weeks, four island stops, one sea. Start at HKT or KBV. Finish at Pak Bara and fly out of Hat Yai. May to October is the wrong window.

title: 10 days Gulf islands: Samui, Phangan, Tao
sub: This Gulf hop is beach nights plus Tao diving. Fly into USM. Boat with Lomprayah. Skip it in November swell if you need a guaranteed sea.
body: This Gulf hop is beach nights plus Tao diving. Fly into USM. Boat with Lomprayah. Skip it in November swell if you need a guaranteed sea. Ten Gulf days work when each island has a role. Samui is the airport and the easy beach. Phangan is bays, not only Haad Rin. Tao is the Open Water card and the west-coast viewpoints. Lomprayah is the first boat to book. Seatran Discovery and Songserm are the backup desks, not a third sea. January to September is the easier Lower Gulf window. May to August is the calmest, clearest sea, when the Andaman parks are shut. October to December is swell season; fast boats cancel first. The Lomprayah Samui to Thong Sala catamaran is about 30 minutes. Seatran takes about 45. Phangan to Tao (Thong Sala to Mae Haad) is about 1 to 1.5 hours on Lomprayah: the catamaran about 1 hour, the midday ferry about 1.5 hours. Songserm and Seatran Discovery use the same piers; check the boat on the day. Tao collects about 20 THB on arrival. Read the Samui pier: Nathon for many Lomprayah tickets, Maenam / Pralarn for others, Bangrak for Seatran, Lipa Noi for Raja. title: 7 days Northern Thailand loop
sub: This north loop is Lanna wats, a mountain night in Pai, and Chiang Rai temples. Use Prempracha from Arcade Terminal 2. Use Green Bus VIP for Chiang Rai.
body: This north loop is Lanna wats, a mountain night in Pai, and Chiang Rai temples. Use Prempracha from Arcade Terminal 2. Use Green Bus VIP for Chiang Rai. Seven north days fit Chiang Mai, one mountain day, Pai, and Chiang Rai. They do not fit the full 600 km Mae Hong Son Loop. title: Similan and Surin Islands
sub: These parks are granite boulders, clear water, and Richelieu Rock liveaboards. Day boats leave Tab Lamu Pier. Sleep in Khao Lak, not Patong.

Mu Ko Similan and Mu Ko Surin are separate national parks in the Andaman, not hotel islands. Both open 15 October to 15 May and close 16 May to 14 October so the reef can rest and so the southwest monsoon does not sink day boats. Foreign adults pay 500 THB at each park, children 250 THB. Divers often pay an extra daily fee. Buy the DNP e-ticket when the desk is live, and still carry cash. Similan day boats leave Tab Lamu Pier (also written Thap Lamu), south of Khao Lak in Thai Mueang. The run is about 70 km and about 1.5 hours by speedboat. Phuket pickups add a long pre-dawn road. Surin sits farther north. Khuraburi is the usual Surin pier. Richelieu Rock is a Surin pinnacle, not a Similan snorkel stop. If Richelieu is the point, book a liveaboard, not a Donald Duck Bay day boat. title: Damnoen Saduak and Amphawa floating markets
sub: Use Damnoen Saduak if you need a morning canal on any weekday. Use Amphawa if you want local seafood on a weekend evening. Maeklong trains pass at 08:30, 11:10, 14:30, and 17:40.
body: Use Damnoen Saduak if you need a morning canal on any weekday. Use Amphawa if you want local seafood on a weekend evening. Maeklong trains pass at 08:30, 11:10, 14:30, and 17:40. Damnoen Saduak in Ratchaburi is the daily morning canal. Boats and stalls run about 07:00 to 11:00. After that the water empties. A private longtail for a short loop is 1,500 to 2,000 THB in 2026. Shared boats are cheaper and more stop-start. Tour buses photograph this canal. Go early or skip it. Amphawa in Samut Songkhram is the weekend evening market, Friday to Sunday about 14:00 to 20:30. You walk the boards, eat grilled seafood, and optionally take a firefly boat for 60 to 100 THB after dusk. Book a no-hook, no-show camp if you want to watch and feed, not ride; the van is part of the 2026 price. The useful Chiang Mai elephant day is a sanctuary that lets you walk, feed, and watch. It does not put you on a neck, in a howdah, or in a painting show. Mae Taeng is the northern valley. Mae Wang is south-west toward the Doi Inthanon roads. Half-day trips run 1,800 to 2,500 THB in 2026. Full days run 2,500 to 3,500 THB. Hotel pickup in a shared van is usually in the price. The drive is about 1 to 1.5 hours each way. Book direct or through a Klook listing that states no riding in the inclusions, not through a soi tout on Monday night. title: Sanctuary of Truth, Pattaya
sub: The Sanctuary of Truth is known for a 105-metre-high carved wooden hall on the Naklua waterfront, built of teak and other hardwoods with traditional joinery. Best as a Pattaya morning for a guided hard-hat walk, not a beach-club stop.
body: The Sanctuary of Truth is known for a 105-metre-high carved wooden hall on the Naklua waterfront, built of teak and other hardwoods with traditional joinery. Best as a Pattaya morning for a guided hard-hat walk, not a beach-club stop. The Sanctuary of Truth (Prasat Sut Ja-Tum) stands on the Naklua waterfront north of central Pattaya. The carved hall is 105 metres high and about 100 metres on each side. The main structure uses teak plus mai daeng, mai takien, and mai panchart, assembled with traditional wood joinery and no metal nails. Construction has been ongoing since the 1980s. Foreign daytime entry is 500 THB in 2026. Hours are 08:00 to 18:00, run as guided slots. You wear a helmet because this is still a worksite as well as a monument. An evening session with lights runs on selected nights; check the desk the week you go. Cover knees and shoulders. The same rule as a wat applies even though this is a private foundation, not a royal temple. Grab from Walking Street is 20 to 30 minutes depending on the beach road. A baht bus to Naklua is cheaper and slower. This is not a first-trip substitute for Ayutthaya or the Grand Palace. title: Or Tor Kor and Bangkok fresh markets
sub: Come for monthong durian, Royal Project fruit, and curry-over-rice in cool air, not a night bazaar. It fits a Saturday if Chatuchak is already the plan. Khlong Toei is the raw wet-market contrast.
body: Come for monthong durian, Royal Project fruit, and curry-over-rice in cool air, not a night bazaar. It fits a Saturday if Chatuchak is already the plan. Khlong Toei is the raw wet-market contrast. Or Tor Kor Market (the Agricultural Wholesale Market Organization hall) sits at MRT Kamphaeng Phet Exit 3, across Kamphaeng Phet Road from Chatuchak. title: Bangkok and Chiang Mai coffee guide
sub: Drink filter and espresso from northern Thai Arabica, not only instant on ice. This guide fits cafe hoppers in Ari or Nimman who will pay 80 to 160 THB and sit still for a pour-over.
body: Drink filter and espresso from northern Thai Arabica, not only instant on ice. This guide fits cafe hoppers in Ari or Nimman who will pay 80 to 160 THB and sit still for a pour-over. Thailand's specialty scene is highland Arabica from Chiang Rai (Maejantai village in Mae Suai District, Doi Chang, Doi Tung) and the Chiang Mai hills, roasted in city rooms. A 2026 filter or espresso is 80 to 160 THB. Iced is still the default; ask for hot if you want the origin. Factory Coffee sits near Phaya Thai ARL, useful on a Bangkok arrival day. title: Thailand beaches and island hopping guide
sub: Thai beaches are known for three coasts with different dry months. Pick one sea first: Andaman November to April, Lower Gulf January to August, or the east coast November to April.
body: Thai beaches are known for three coasts with different dry months. Pick one sea first: Andaman November to April, Lower Gulf January to August, or the east coast November to April. The Andaman coast (Phuket, Krabi, Phi Phi, Koh Lanta, Koh Lipe) is known for calmer seas from November to April. The Lower Gulf (Koh Samui, Koh Phangan, Koh Tao) stays drier January to August and takes its heaviest rain from October to early December. The eastern seaboard (Koh Samet, Koh Chang, Koh Kood) follows the Andaman clock: November to April. Pick one coast. See [Phuket](/phuket), [Koh Samui](/koh-samui), and [Koh Chang and Koh Kood](/koh-chang-and-koh-kood). Longtails are cheap, wet, and local: Railay crossings run about 100 THB a person. Speedboats cut time and add spray; they cancel in swell. Marine national park fees for a foreign adult sit at 200 to 400 THB at the pier or the beach desk. Confirm whether a Klook boat includes the fee. For a 10-day Andaman hop, use [2 weeks Andaman](/itineraries/2-weeks-andaman-island-hopping) or cut it to one base. title: Thailand with kids and families
sub: Thailand with kids is known for shallow west-coast beaches, Chiang Mai ethical elephant half-days, and Bangkok aquarium breaks. Fits families who bring a travel car seat or book a private van.
body: Thailand with kids is known for shallow west-coast beaches, Chiang Mai ethical elephant half-days, and Bangkok aquarium breaks. Fits families who bring a travel car seat or book a private van. Thailand works for families because distances are short, food is mild if you ask, and hospitals in the main cities are used to foreign patients. The hard part is the road. Street taxis and many Grabs have no child seat and often no rear seatbelt you trust. Bring a travel car seat, or book a private Klook or Trip.com van that lists child seats (a 2026 BKK-to-hotel van is often 1,200 to 2,000 THB). Do not assume the airport taxi has one. Calm, shallow beaches for small kids: Kata, Kamala, and Bang Tao on Phuket; Choeng Mon on Samui; Klong Dao on Koh Lanta. Skip Patong and Chaweng as a first beach with toddlers. Chiang Mai ethical elephant half-days sit on [elephant sanctuaries](/attractions/chiang-mai-ethical-elephant-sanctuaries). Bangkok heat breaks: SEA LIFE Bangkok Ocean World at Siam Paragon. Hospitals: Bumrungrad and Samitivej in Bangkok; Bangkok Hospital Phuket and Bangkok Hospital Samui on the islands. title: 5 days in Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai: northern culture and mountains
sub: Known for Old City wats, a 07:00 Doi Suthep run, Khao Soi Mae Sai, and a White, Blue, and Black House day. Fits first north trips that skip the Pai van.
body: Known for Old City wats, a 07:00 Doi Suthep run, Khao Soi Mae Sai, and a White, Blue, and Black House day. Fits first north trips that skip the Pai van. Five north days are known for a Chiang Mai base and one Chiang Rai temple circuit. Sleep three nights in the [Old City](/chiang-mai/old-city) or Nimman. Walk Wat Chedi Luang and Wat Phra Singh. Leave at 07:00 for [Doi Suthep](/attractions/wat-phra-that-doi-suthep) (30 THB, songthaew 60 to 100 THB each way). Lunch at Khao Soi Mae Sai on Ratchaphuek Road: 55 to 90 THB, Monday to Saturday 08:00 to 16:00, closed Sunday. Book an [ethical elephant half-day](/attractions/chiang-mai-ethical-elephant-sanctuaries). Saturday is Wua Lai Walking Street. Sunday is Ratchadamnoen Walking Street. Use two nights in [Chiang Rai](/chiang-rai), or one full-day GreenBus VIP or private van if you refuse a second hotel. title: 3 weeks in Thailand: grand north-to-south route
sub: Known for the full 21-day overland and island loop: city, ruins, north, then one south sea. Fits travellers who fly north-to-south once and pick Andaman or Gulf islands by month.
body: Known for the full 21-day overland and island loop: city, ruins, north, then one south sea. Fits travellers who fly north-to-south once and pick Andaman or Gulf islands by month. Three weeks are known for a north-to-south country loop with one long south flight. Days 1 to 4 stay in Bangkok for temples, Chinatown, and one market. Day 5 is an [Ayutthaya](/ayutthaya) day (about 60 to 90 minutes by train) or the overnight sleeper north (SRT 9, about 12 hours). Days 6 to 10 cover [Chiang Mai](/chiang-mai) and [Chiang Rai](/chiang-rai), or a Pai minivan loop of about 3 to 4.5 hours on Highway 1095. Do not do Pai and Chiang Rai as rushed same-day adds. Day 11 flies north-to-south to Phuket (HKT), Krabi (KBV), or Surat Thani (URT). Days 11 to 14 are [Khao Sok](/khao-sok) (Cheow Lan Lake, 300 THB) and [Krabi](/krabi) (Railay or Ao Nang). Days 15 to 20 pick one island group by monsoon: [Koh Lanta](/koh-lanta) on the Andaman (November to April), or Koh Tao, [Koh Phangan](/koh-phangan), and [Koh Samui](/koh-samui) on the Gulf (January to September). Day 21 returns to Bangkok for the long-haul. Fly the long legs. Drop a night before you add a second sea. A 72-hour food stopover tickets the royal river first, then eats after dark. Sleep beside a BTS exit on [Sukhumvit](/bangkok/sukhumvit) or [Siam](/bangkok/siam-silom) so Octave at Soi 57 is a last-night walk, not a taxi hunt. Dinner is [Wang Lang](/thai-food/wang-lang-and-talat-noi) or [Yaowarat](/thai-food/yaowarat-chinatown-food-walk) via MRT Wat Mangkon Exit 1. Day 2 is [Chatuchak](/attractions/chatuchak-weekend-market) on Saturday or Sunday, or [Or Tor Kor](/thai-food/or-tor-kor-and-bangkok-fresh-markets) any day, both at MRT Kamphaeng Phet. Night food is [Banthat Thong](/thai-food/banthat-thong-road-food-strip). Day 3 is Talat Noi lanes, then one roof: Octave at Soi 57, BTS Thong Lo Exit 3. title: Khao Lak vs Phuket: Same Sea, Lower Rates
sub: Khao Lak wins on space and price. Phuket wins on nightlife, food choice, and short transfers. Pick by how you want the evenings to go.
body: Khao Lak wins on space and price. Phuket wins on nightlife, food choice, and short transfers. Pick by how you want the evenings to go. title: Where to stay on Koh Lanta
sub: Koh Lanta is known for a long west-coast hotel road rather than one village, so sleep Klong Dao if you want dinner and sleep farther south if you want a quieter bay. Name the beach before you search the island.
body: Koh Lanta is known for a long west-coast hotel road rather than one village, so sleep Klong Dao if you want dinner and sleep farther south if you want a quieter bay. Name the beach before you search the island. The west-coast road drops south from Saladan, and [Klong Dao](/koh-lanta/beaches) is the first useful sand: shallow water and dinner. Long Beach is next, and Klong Khong and Klong Nin sit mid-island. Kantiang and the far south are quieter and a longer transfer, and Saladan itself is a port town. Sleep on a beach if you can. Reach Lanta from KBV by van plus the car ferry from Hua Hin pier on the Krabi side (not the Hua Hin resort town), or by Saladan passenger boat from about November to April (about 2 to 2.5 hours). [Hua Hin](/hua-hin) is the upper western Gulf, not Samui and not the Andaman, and November to April is the dry, busy window.
